title: Roadmap storyboard and fidelity matrix for upcoming exec readout
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Assemble a concise, decision-oriented exec packet that combines a storyboard (narrative flow of product themes) with a fidelity matrix that surfaces which initiatives are ready for commitment vs. require more investment or experimentation. The packet will be used for the monthly exec readout and by leadership during the QBR prep window.

Goals: 1) Give execs a one-scan view of runway for major initiatives (Serving runtime, Dedicated, Private/VPC, Console, Optimize). 2) Highlight 2–3 decision points with recommended options and cost/benefit tradeoffs. 3) Surface high-confidence metrics and where we need to de-risk before committing (technical unknowns, customer onboarding constraints).

Scope & deliverables: - 6-slide storyboard: narrative arc (context, opportunity, progress, options, recommended ask, risks & mitigations). - Fidelity matrix (CSV-style table embedded in the packet) mapping each initiative to: definition of done, required investment (FTE/infra), key unknowns, impact metric, timing, and confidence level (High/Medium/Low). - Executive one-pager that summarizes asks and required decisions. - Backup data appendix with dashboards: latency SLO trends, per-token cost delta by quantization profile, Dedicated capacity utilization forecast, and model-regression comparison.

Key decision asks (for exec): - Approve pilot expansion for Dedicated capacity for two enterprise customers (resource delta: +3 GPUs / month; expected revenue capture: $60k ARR). Options: Approve, Approve with guardrails, Defer. - Prioritize runtime kernel optimization work vs. Console rollout polish for Q3 sprint slices. Options: Reallocate 2 engs to runtime, keep current staffing, hire contract kernel perf engineer. - Accept proposed release window for Private v1.2 (May) with an extended compliance QA window, or delay until JUL release with lower operational risk.

Metrics to include: - Latency P95 and P99 by model family (last 8 weeks). - Cost per generated token by model variant (baseline vs. quantized). - Dedicated pool utilization and headroom projection (next 90 days). - Customer escalations and SLO breach incidents (count + severity). - Adoption velocity signals: API keys created, paid onboarding conversions in pilot accounts.

Audience & tone: Exec leadership + GTM leads. Keep narrative crisp, visually simple (bulletized asks with one recommended option each), and ensure data provenance for every claim (link to dashboard or PRD).

Why this is different from past readouts: Instead of a long slide dump, this packet enforces a fidelity taxonomy (Ready / Needs De-risk / Research) and ties each row to a quantified ask (people, infra, timeline) so exec decisions map directly to resource commits.

Acceptance criteria: - Packet reviewed and signed off by Eng leads (runtime, infra, console) and Revenue Ops. - Deck under 8 slides + appendix. - Each decision tile includes recommended fallback and measurement plan.

Risks & mitigations: - Risk: Kernel optimization estimates may be optimistic; Mitigation: Include contingency buffer + phased ramp plan. - Risk: Customer readiness for Dedicated may be slower than forecast; Mitigation: require 2 pilot accounts to sign LOIs before full allocation. - Risk: Release window slip for Private v1.2 due to compliance; Mitigation: expand QA parallelization and freeze noncritical changes earlier.

Where to find artifacts: - Draft storyboard deck: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-roadmap-stories (draft v0.3) - Fidelity matrix (working CSV): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1fidelity-matrix - PRD for Dedicated expansion: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/Dedicated-PRD - Latency & cost dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/ops/latency-cost - Related GitHub discussion on kernel perf: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1623

Next steps: 1) Complete data appendix and finalize graphs (owner: Marcelo, due 2026-02-22). 2) Leadership dry run and feedback capture (owner: Aisha, due 2026-02-26). 3) Finalize packet and circulate (owner: Marcello, due 2026-03-03).
